wire_policy.version_constraint: DolphinScheduler 1.3.9 compiles supported task fields into a guarded whole-workflow update while preserving string ids and opaque graph fields; 2.0.0 deliberately avoids its unsafe standalone task endpoint and compiles into the complete process-definition transaction so task and relation versions advance together; 2.0.9 preserves existing relations for ordinary field edits and rejects explicit depends_on before transport; 3.0.0, 3.0.6, and 3.1.0 use updateTaskWithUpstream; 3.1.9 rejects that dependency route because valid-code removal empties the set guarding updateDag; 3.2.0 rejects it because the route updates current upstream relations without calling updateDag; both use standalone ordinary-field updates with prepare/apply unique-workflow binding proofs; 3.2.1 onward use updateTaskWithUpstream
